t2i_prompt: A 1440 px wide desktop web section as a flat straight-on UI mockup on warm limestone. Top left: a small breadcrumb, a large light-weight sans headline, a light subhead and a short intro. Left half: a four-row table with mono row numerals, small sans headers and hairline rules for <CONTENT>. Right: a soft 3D isometric render of one matte white polypropylene skid with blocky tanks, round columns and a clear pipe of translucent pale-blue water on a white base plate, in even studio light, bleeding off the right edge. Hairline leaders with small square markers run from each row end into the skid.
signature_idea: Each limit row of the table runs a hairline leader into the white PP skid, tying a number on paper to a point on the equipment.
strengths: shows the actual product: a white PP skid with pale-blue water
table is clear, calm and legible with mono numerals
leaders connect data to the equipment as the brief asked
limestone, navy text and white render keep the palette quiet
weaknesses: leaders end on arbitrary spots of the skid; the levels have no physical location
intro line is the prompt's company description pasted as copy
invented figures and document codes (CFU limit, USP number, GUI code) in cells
skid is toy-like blocks with rounded corners, not a believable PP system
no steel-blue accent; leaders are grey
brand_fit_why: Light headline, mono numerals, limestone and white PP render are on-brand and calm, but the leaders mean nothing and the copy and figures are invented.
